description:
## Why

PKIX-9vnx.5 shipped the emit half: `pkix_lint::oscal::emit::risks_from_store(&DeviationStore) -> Vec<Value>` projects a deviation policy as a JSON array of OSCAL Risk objects. The persistence story is only complete when a parser can read those Risks back into a `DeviationStore` losslessly.

## What

Implement `pkix_lint::oscal::parse::deviation_store_from_risks(value: &Value) -> Result<DeviationStore, Error>` that walks a JSON array of OSCAL Risk objects (in the shape emitted by `risks_from_store`) and reconstructs the original `DeviationStore`.

Field decoding mirrors the emit:
- `uuid` ignored on parse (regenerated deterministically by future emits).
- `description` / `statement` → `justification`.
- `status` validated against `"deviation-approved"`; reject otherwise (other OSCAL Risk statuses are out of scope for pkix-lint deviation policy).
- Props decoded by name:
  - `pkix-lint.deviation-id` → `Deviation::id` (required).
  - `pkix-lint.target-lint` → `target_lint` (required).
  - `pkix-lint.action` → `DeviationAction`: literal `"suppress"` or `"downgrade:<severity-label>"` (required).
  - `pkix-lint.authorized-by` → `authorized_by` (required, non-empty).
  - `pkix-lint.effective-start` / `pkix-lint.effective-end` → `Option<u64>` (parsed as decimal u64; absent = None).
- Subjects decoded by type discriminator:
  - `pkix-lint.scope.any` → `DeviationScope::Any`.
  - `pkix-lint.scope.issuer-dn-contains` → `DeviationScope::IssuerDnContains(<substring prop>)`.
  - `pkix-lint.scope.issuer-dn-exact` → `DeviationScope::IssuerDnExact(Name::from_der(hex_decode(<dn-der prop>)))`. The DER prop is the lossless oracle; the human-readable `pkix-lint.issuer-dn` prop is informational only.
  - `pkix-lint.scope.serial-range` → `DeviationScope::SerialRange { issuer: Name::from_der(...), start: hex_decode(...), end: hex_decode(...) }`.
- `links` with `rel=reference` → `evidence_uri` (first matching link).

## Acceptance

- [ ] `emit::risks_from_store` → `parse::deviation_store_from_risks` is a closed loop: `(emit . parse)` over a non-empty store yields an `Eq`-equal store.
- [ ] Malformed inputs return descriptive errors (missing required prop, unknown subject type, malformed DER, malformed hex, unknown action string, etc.) — not panics.
- [ ] At least one test covers each of the four DeviationScope variants in a round-trip.
- [ ] At least one test covers the optional-field handling (effective_start=None, effective_end=None, evidence_uri=None).

## Out of scope

- Reading OSCAL Risk objects produced by other tools (e.g., a POA&M from a different OSCAL emitter). pkix-lint's parser specifically targets pkix-lint's own emit shape — a stricter contract for round-trip integrity.

## Filed by

PKIX-9vnx.5 closure 2026-05-11 (the emit half landed; this is the parse half).
title: pkix-lint: OSCAL Risk parser for DeviationStore round-trip
